competitiveTarget: Beat portal city-directory pages with leftover regional inventory and a ledger of Central Oregon cities, not a link farm.
note: PAGE_INVENTORY §3 (2026-09-06 Wave H). A–Z directory. Live counts on the rows, doors. Not a mini-Bend KPI Instrument. Caption carries the region count and months-of-supply verdict. Section order: V3Breadcrumb, Ledger (every city A–Z), Quiet (the rest of each city's doors), Sheet (SFR alerts), Quiet (edges), V3Footer outside main. Chrome is layout-owned V3Chrome. Do not remount it. Capture: submitSearchAlertSignup with city empty and propertyType A, via RegionalAlertSheet (trap name company).

requiredComponents.name: V3SectionTracker
requiredComponents.section: tracking — section_view telemetry. pageType=index. Wiring, not visual language.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: structured data — breadcrumb + Dataset schema; CollectionPage + ItemList rendered inline. JSON-LD is not visual language, so this one flat-register import stays and ci:public-ui counts it.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: breadcrumb — Home / Cities. JSON-LD is in MetadataBlock.

requiredComponents.name: V3Ledger
requiredComponents.section: Ledger — every city A–Z. Every row a door, the live count in the value column. Caption, not a five-number Instrument.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: Quiet — the second, third and fourth door per city, then the page's outbound edges and the Oregon Data Share citation.

requiredComponents.name: RegionalAlertSheet
requiredComponents.section: SFR listing-alert capture, as a barrel Sheet. Same submitSearchAlertSignup payload and same company trap the KB band posted.

requiredComponents.name: leftoverHudKpis
requiredComponents.section: Ledger caption — leftover region stats (active count, median list, months of supply). Miss omits.

requiredComponents.name: getDetachedOverlays
requiredComponents.section: Ledger — leftover per-city active count and median. Miss omits.

requiredComponents.name: cityHero
requiredComponents.section: Ledger media — verified per-city photography only. Unverified cities get no photo.

requiredComponents.name: cityFeaturedLinks
requiredComponents.section: Quiet — guide, inventory and open-house doors per city, plus Bend's luxury page (G7, ci:westside-backlog).

layoutComponents.name: V3Chrome
layoutComponents.section: layout-owned public header. Pages must not remount it.
layoutComponents.note: Not in requiredComponents because the gate checks the route file. app/layout.tsx mounts it.

MarketSources (Oregon Data Share citation is the Instrument source line plus a Quiet edge)
